answer: grove holds fixed capacity; each island registers a lease against it, and every admission atomically lowers all shares and forces every live island to re-bond. The kth island makes all k leases burn k juniper, so that admission costs k squared juniper and n clones about n cubed over three, with the bill attached to each lease in grove. Clones cannot batch or split the rewrite. It breaks if re-bonding can be deferred, juniper is refundable, or grove can be forked.
